scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed competent mechanical work — querying the binlog for errors, projects, and properties — but reached fundamentally incorrect conclusions. It failed to identify that LrgWindowsAppManifest was not actually part of the solution build (despite appearing in the binlog), and consequently couldn't connect the dots about how this leads to the missing output file. The core diagnostic insight expected by the rubric was missed entirely.
